reviews.comment: She is so nice and a great lecturer. She really helps you grasp the concepts with examples and practice questions. Weekly quizzes are hard, but prep you for tests. Grade is mainly based on the quizzes and tests, so study for those. Concepts are not super hard, but questions can get tricky. Would also usually let us out 20 mins early lol.

2 exams and 1 cumulative final, weekly lockdown browser quizzes (difficult, but 4 attempts allowed), an essay, and some group work. Lectures are necessary but you'll also need to read the textbook and practice to truly grasp the material. This class is very conceptual, logical, and vocab-heavy with no math.  Puccia is nice and a thorough lecturer.
